name: eVisa (Short-Term Visitor)

requirements.blocker_text: Passport must be valid for at least 6 months.
Requires payment of the non-refundable TTD 400 eVisa fee by Visa or Mastercard.

outcome.duration_length: duration of the approved stay (multiple-entry eVisa)

sources.title: ttconnect, Government of Trinidad and Tobago -- Visa & Student Permit: eVisa for visa-required nationals, TTD 400 fee, 6-month passport validity, multiple-entry, 5-step online process

notes: NEW COUNTRY, first route of Trinidad and Tobago's initial build. Trinidad and Tobago is a sovereign Commonwealth republic (ISO TT) -- not a British Overseas Territory and not a Kingdom-of-the-Netherlands constituent country, so it has its own independent citizenship regime under the Citizenship of the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago Act, Chapter 1:50 (see tt_naturalisation.json, tt_registration_commonwealth.json, tt_citizenship_by_descent.json). This eVisa applies only to nationals of visa-required countries; visa-exempt nationals (including CARICOM and many Commonwealth/EU/North American nationals) enter without this process -- no separate visa-exempt entry route was modelled since the source describes only the paid-visa process in detail. No maximum stay duration in days was stated beyond 'the duration of their approved stay' -- flagged as a gap rather than assumed.
